```python
        date_part = match.group(1)
        file_name_part = match.group(2)
        extension = match.group(3)
        new_file_name = f"{file_name_part}/{date_part}{extension}"
        files_to_rename.append((file_path, new_file_name))
        print(f"Found file to rename: {file_path} -> {new_file_name}")
```
